answer: Group identities into clusters by shared funding and behaviour, then price admission quadratically inside each cluster: the first identity stakes 10 POA, the second 40, the third 90, locked four epochs, so ten linked fakes cost 3,850 POA instead of 100. Clusters surface like karst, hidden channels joining accounts that look unrelated. Auditors replay the ledger layer by layer, like shale, and a cluster convicted of sybil control loses its stake. An honest agent plants one cedar and pays 10; an attacker must fund a forest at quadratic prices, while the chain verifies each link from records.
